summary.text: Stephen Owens is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 31 (Harvey County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.
Stephen Owens is listed as a vice chair of the Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Stephen Owens served in the House (2019–2024) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2025.
Stephen Owens is listed as a member of the Commerce Committee, the Assessment and Taxation Committee, the Public Health and Welfare Committee and the Ways and Means Committee.
The Legislature lists Stephen Owens's occupation as Self-employed.
The page names Rose Owens as Stephen Owens's spouse.
